name: Necromancer Mutation halves the tick period of diseases applied during it (#679)
contract: Mutation 500342 is a Death talent with its own CharacterAdvancement row (4620, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 59 Death, TalentEssenceCost 1), not a tooltip carrier: an instant self-cast with a 3 min RecoveryTime and DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms. Its description reads 'For the next $d your diseases mutate ... allowing your freshly applied diseases to tick $s1% faster.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) MiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, the periodic period) with BasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50 and EffectSpellClassMask (0x0800C000, 0x04800000, 0x400) in SpellFamilyName 29, which covers Flesh to Worms 500338 (family flags 0x4000, 0, 0x20; PERIODIC_DAMAGE every 3000 ms). Effect 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) has amount 0. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic applies the caster's SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME when a periodic aura is created, so a Flesh to Worms applied before Mutation keeps its 3000 ms period, a Flesh to Worms applied while Mutation is active ticks every 1500 ms (two ticks within 3.1 s instead of one), and the earlier disease is not changed.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Disease the first golem before Mutation
SETUP: the first golem carries Flesh to Worms
CONTROL: without Mutation Flesh to Worms ticks every 3 sec
Mutation is active on the Necromancer
Disease the second golem during Mutation
SETUP: the second golem carries Flesh to Worms
DISCRIMINATING: the freshly applied disease ticks every 1.5 sec
The disease applied before Mutation keeps its 3 sec period
Let 3.1 sec of the fresh disease elapse
The fresh disease ticked twice in 3.1 sec
